t: r/newbrunswickcanada on Reddit: NB power rates out of control
s: May 12, 2024 - The people who work for NB Power also live in New Brunswick and spend their money in New Brunswick. Private ownership would be likely to come from outside the province, or even the country. If they fire most of the staff and keep only the people whondo repairs, all those "savings" will leave the province. As well, if you live rurally, you're SOL because the rural areas aren't profitable at all from a business perspective. Any private buyer would likely try to negotiate only for the urban centres and the generators, leaving rural people out to dry.
